up: Retrieve approved drugs from ChEMBL together with preferred name, canonical SMILES, EFO identifier, EFO indication label, and max phase for indication. Keep only approved drugs with max_phase = 4, require non-null EFO identifier and non-null EFO indication label, and return DISTINCT rows only for exactly chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  di.efo_id AS indication_curie,
  di.efo_term AS indication_label,
  di.max_phase_for_ind
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4
  AND di.efo_id IS NOT NULL
  AND di.efo_term IS NOT NULL;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  di.efo_id AS indication_curie,
  di.efo_term AS indication_label,
  di.max_phase_for_ind
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno
WHERE di.max_phase_for_ind = 4
  AND di.efo_id IS NOT NULL
